page_title: VLL 2-3 OSA | Valladolid v Osasuna 20/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Stanko Juric (Valladolid) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jesus Manzano saw the whole situation.
90+6' Andre Ferreira (Valladolid) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
90+3' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
90+1' The whistle blows and Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) is booked for an infringement.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Adam Aznou (Valladolid) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
89' What a miskick by Mario Martin (Valladolid). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
87' Substitution. Iker Munoz (Osasuna) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Pablo Ibanez walks off.
86' Vicente Moreno has decided to substitute Jesus Areso and he is replaced by Ruben Pena (Osasuna).
86' Dangerous play by Adam Aznou (Valladolid). Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
86' The manager makes a subsitution with Marcos Andre (Valladolid) coming on for Juanmi Latasa.
82' Raul Moro (Valladolid) jinks his way past multiple challenges and fires the ball from the edge of the box towards the roof of the net, but Sergio Herrera shows his agility and makes a save.

80' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) clutches his head in despair after blowing a huge opportunity! He receives the ball from the set piece and takes a good first touch to unleash a low shot, but Andre Ferreira makes a nice save.
79' Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
78' A clumsy foul by Adam Aznou (Valladolid) and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle.
75' Neat passing move from Valladolid in order to create new attacking opportunities.
73' That's the end of the game for Ruben Garcia, who is replaced by Moi Gomez (Osasuna).
72' Jesus Manzano has a clear sight and sees a foul from Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna). Free kick. Valladolid will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
71' The game is interrupted now, Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
70' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) meets a cross inside the box, but Sergio Herrera wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
66' 2 - 3 Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) easily converts the penalty kick as he sends the ball straight into the bottom left corner, ricocheting in off the post. Sergio Herrera was helpless.
66' Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) is going to take the penalty!
65' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jesus Manzano blows for a foul. The referee uncompromisingly points to the spot and it's a penalty to Valladolid.
63' Alvaro Rubio has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mario Martin (Valladolid) replacing Chuki.
63' Here comes a substitution. Adam Aznou (Valladolid) is brought on as a substitute for Henrique.
62' Good work from Valladolid as they win a corner.
60' 1 - 3 Goal! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Andre Ferreira into right side of the goal.
60' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
59' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Valladolid is cautioned for aggressive play. A penalty is awarded to Osasuna!
59' Osasuna work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

59' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by Andre Ferreira, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The linesman points to the corner flag, Osasuna are going to take it.
57' CLOSE! Abel Bretones (Osasuna) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that whistles over the bar.

54' A cross by Chuki (Valladolid) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
53' Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) displays his superb passing ability after picking out Juanmi Latasa with a fine lofted pass to continue their attacking move.
52' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.

49' 1 - 2 An amazing individual effort from Raul Moro (Valladolid) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and makes it 1:2. Sergio Herrera was helpless.

48' A big opportunity is wasted by Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the bottom left corner. Unfortunately for him, Sergio Herrera pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.
47' Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) tries to find Mamadou Sylla, but he puts too much power on the pass.
46' Here is a change. Darwin Machis is going off and Alvaro Rubio gives the last tactical orders to Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid).
46' Here's the change. Florian Grillitsch leaves the pitch and Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) comes on as a substitute.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' Jesus Manzano has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+3' Raul Moro (Valladolid) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' Osasuna are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
44' A raking crossfield pass from Jesus Areso (Osasuna) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
42' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Andre Ferreira, who smothers the ball.
41' Chuki (Valladolid) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going low in the middle of the goal, but Sergio Herrera has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
40' Darwin Machis (Valladolid) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
40' The ball is out of play. Valladolid will have a chance to score from a corner.
38' This shall not pass! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.

37' Stanko Juric (Valladolid) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Sergio Herrera!
34' 0 - 2 Goal - 0:2! Jesus Areso tees up Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Andre Ferreira.
33' The ball is behind the sideline. Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) takes a throw-in.
31' A crossfield pass from Antonio Candela (Valladolid) fails to find any of his teammates.
29' 2:6 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
28' Chuki (Valladolid) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
27' Foul! Darwin Machis (Valladolid) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. Osasuna will take a free kick near the side line.
27' Jesus Manzano interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jorge Herrando (Osasuna).
26' The referee blows his whistle, Valladolid are awarded a corner kick.
25' Chuki (Valladolid) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Sergio Herrera comes off the line to clear the ball away.
23' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Darwin Machis (Valladolid) sends it out of play. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
23' Jesus Manzano blows his whistle after Abel Bretones (Osasuna) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. A free kick is awarded to Valladolid.
22' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) attempts to find Ante Budimir, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
20' There's an opportunity for Darwin Machis (Valladolid) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
19' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Valladolid have a free kick.
19' A cross into the box from Darwin Machis (Valladolid) is cleared.

18' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from long range which went towards the middle of the goal, but Andre Ferreira was ready and made a save.

16' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Valladolid, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
15' Florian Grillitsch (Valladolid) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jesus Manzano signals.
13' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is out of play. Valladolid will take a throw-in.
11' Darwin Machis (Valladolid) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

9' 0 - 1 Ruben Garcia sends a superb cross into the box. Ante Budimir (Osasuna) latches on to it and from close range plants a header into the bottom left corner, leaving Andre Ferreira beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 0:1.
7' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) sends the corner into the box, but Andre Ferreira intercepts it and averts the threat.
6' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) is substituted due to injury. Vicente Moreno gives a chance to Pablo Ibanez.
5' Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.
5' Antonio Candela (Valladolid) sends a lovely cross into the penalty area and Juanmi Latasa attempts to score after getting on the end of it.
3' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
2' Osasuna are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
1' The first half has started.
Osasuna will kick the game off.
Jesus Manzano will supervise the game today.
